body:
Context (issue #501, follow-up to #500/T-01KZXG6XAYFZ62TF4P6YBW6WXG): the documented entry points `npm run preflight` and `npm test` resolve through root `package.json`'s mutable `scripts` block. A PR can redirect `scripts.preflight` away from `scripts/preflight.mjs` or `scripts.test` away from the test runner without touching any frozen file — bypassing the enforcement chain at its outermost entry point. Blanket freezing of `package.json` without exemption would turn every release into a #141 ceremony because releases bump `package.json` version and internal dependency pins. What is needed is adding root `package.json` as an immutable trust root while extending trust-root enforcement to recognize the version-only manifest exemption (ADR 0012).

Build:
1. **Declare root package.json an immutable trust root and code owner.** Add `package.json` to `DEFAULT_IMMUTABLE_TRUST_ROOTS` in `packages/rails-guard/lib/ci/trust-roots.mjs` and `/package.json @voodootikigod` in `CODEOWNERS`.
2. **Exempt version-only manifest changes in trust-root enforcement.** In `packages/rails-guard/lib/ci/rail-freeze.mjs` (`enforceTrustRoots`), check whether changed trust roots that are manifests satisfy `isVersionOnlyChange`. If a manifest trust root change is version-only (pure version bump and lockstep `@adlc/*` repins), exempt it from requiring the #141 ceremony; if it modifies `scripts.preflight`, `scripts.test`, dependencies, or any other field, retain it as an unauthorized trust-root change (failing with exit 2 unless ceremony-authorized).
3. **Behavioral tests & verification.** Add comprehensive unit and integration scenarios in `packages/rails-guard/test/` and `scripts/test/rails-guard-ci.test.mjs` exercising both the fail-closed rejection of script redirections and the clean pass of release-shaped version bumps.

Acceptance criteria (automated tests; failure-path exit codes asserted exactly):
- AC1 Script tampering denied: a PR changing, removing, or redirecting `scripts.preflight` or `scripts.test` in root `package.json` fails the rail-freeze gate (`rails-guard-ci`) with exit 2 naming the trust root violation.
- AC2 Version-only release bump passes: a PR performing a release-shaped version-only bump and lockstep `@adlc/*` repin in root `package.json` (canonical JSON, no other field edits) passes the rail-freeze gate with exit 0 without requiring the #141 ceremony.
- AC3 Non-script, non-version edits denied: adding, removing, or changing any other field (e.g. `main`, dependencies, other scripts) in `package.json` without #141 ceremony fails with exit 2.
- AC4 CODEOWNERS coverage: `CODEOWNERS` includes `/package.json` owned by `@voodootikigod` (verified by `scripts/test/rails-guard-bootstrap-ci.test.mjs` or CODEOWNERS tests).
- AC5 Trust-roots list: `resolveImmutableTrustRoots()` includes `package.json` in default trust roots.
- AC6 Full workspace test suite passes: `npm test` and all 54 segments pass clean.
title: Rail-freeze the package.json script wiring (preflight/test) with a version-only exemption
